description: Per-repair paired arms on the TRANSPORT-FIT-01 Diamond Princess replay. Cell shape verbatim from covid_transport_fit_01_dp (itself verbatim from covid_crew_reach_01 boxed_s1s2): scenario diamond_princess_2020 on the declared mega_cruise_5000 substitution hull, voyage_mode declared (full 35-day voyage), Θ 7.9e6, infection_age_days 6.8, imports 1, dwell_weighted, 20 seeds at base 20200205. The design-level base_overrides carries the whole boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration — SOP-017-MESSBOX + section-bound steward service with contact_factor_to_host [0.005,0.02] + the record's observation structure (retest_negative_sweeps + the 23-Feb crew_wave). Arms switch each airflow repair to its labelled pre-change baseline: room_air_removal.map_arm ambient_on→ambient_off (ROOM-AIR-01 ambient-opening exchange), near_field_air.mode two_box→off (near-field table channel), hvac.pathogen_pool_transport airflow→none (per-pathogen pool transport, AERO-CABIN-03), hvac.duty0_terminal_mode extract→sealed (CONTAM-DUTY0-01 exhaust legs). all_off composes the four baselines — the pre-repair airflow model as a whole. Native transport only: TRANSPORT-FIT-01 measured the solver choice as outcome-identical (paired Δ≈0 on every channel on both hulls), so the contamx axis is not re-run. No constant, protocol, observation channel, seed or hull changes between arms.
base_overrides_note: The boxed_s1s2 resolved configuration of CREW-REACH-01 — identical to TRANSPORT-FIT-01's, applied once to every cell and identical across arms. The arm axis writes only the four repair toggles (map_arm, near_field mode, pool transport, duty0 terminal).

arms.note: First arm so empty overrides per the arm grammar. The shipped repaired model at this revision — seed-pairs against TRANSPORT-FIT-01's native row report-only and against every off-arm on the same seeds exactly.
ROOM-AIR-01 repair off: the ambient-opening exchange removed from the room-air ACH map — transmission.room_air_removal.map_arm ambient_off, the labelled AHU-only baseline (B1's own arm selector).
Near-field air repair off: transmission.near_field_air.mode off — the labelled pre-change baseline; the two_box Keil-2017 table channel removed.
AERO-CABIN-03 repair off: hvac.pathogen_pool_transport none — the labelled pre-change baseline in which no pathogen's airborne pool crosses a zone.
CONTAM-DUTY0-01 repair off: hvac.duty0_terminal_mode sealed — the labelled pre-change baseline that traps mass in the duty-0 sanitary branches.

All four repairs at their labelled pre-change baselines — the pre-repair airflow model. Cross-check against the pre-repair ensemble (~1,351–1,453 pooled lab_confirmed, near-always takeoff): if all_off does not recover it, the dose regression lives outside these four toggles.

cells_note: 6 arms x 20 seeds (20200205..20200224) = 120 cells. The baseline arm re-runs at this revision so every off-arm has an exact seed pair; TRANSPORT-FIT-01's native payloads additionally pair report-only at the older revision.
